declarations.notes: Exact source identity over typed BarnesFirstDomain data; PrincipalPowerPoint records z != 0 and |arg z| < pi, while VerticalLine packages the upward tangent. Convergence is stated separately by dlmf_5_13_1_integrable.

Real a and b are made explicit, as required by the source inequalities a > 0 and 0 < b < pi; convergence is separate in dlmf_5_13_2_integrable. DLMF notes this as the c = 0, b = a, s = i t, z = exp(i(pi - 2b)) specialization of E1, up to t -> -t.
All four complex real-part conditions are preserved in BarnesBetaDomain; its normalized integral and convergence declaration are separate.
Only Re(a+b+c+d) > 3 is assumed, exactly as in the source; the reciprocal-Gamma integrand and convergence declaration are named separately.

Fin 4 indexing records all four parameters and six pairwise Gamma factors. DeBrangesWilsonDomain carries a pole-free parameter subtype; reciprocal-Gamma factors give the removable t = 0 extension of the displayed quotient, and convergence is separate.
